name: Perfect Yeti Hide
summary: At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider is buying yeti hides, and one you found may be perfect. It is thicker and tougher than the hides from the yetis of Rage Scar.

sections.title: A Hide Worth Showing
sections.body: The hide feels thicker and sturdier than those from the yetis of Rage Scar. Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache in Feralas buys yeti hides. This one is worth bringing to him.

sections.title: Jangdor's Verdict
sections.body: Jangdor Swiftstrider delights in the hide and calls it the finest he has ever seen. He offers more than he usually pays for one hide, sure he can make something special from it.

faq.q: Who is interested in the Perfect Yeti Hide?
aliases: who turns in perfect yeti hide
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants to buy yeti hides.

faq.q: Why is this hide considered special?
faq.answer: Its unusual thickness and toughness set it apart from the hides from the yetis of Rage Scar.

aliases: where to bring perfect yeti hide
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider is at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
